browser_suite.description: Real templates and modules with fixture APIs; desktop and mobile

visual_inspection.result: Inspected all 19 desktop/mobile captures and all four final document pages. Fixed low-contrast code in the document table header, then rendered and inspected all pages again. Checked clipping, overflow, overlaps, page breaks, orphan headings, split/repeated table rows, owner/action alignment, headers/footers, readability and branding. Mobile report columns intentionally scroll within the table; inspected both ends. Existing compact UI typography and intentional truncation remain.

limits: No application restart or deployment. Backend changes require normal restart.
Browser APIs use fixtures; live providers and external connectors are not certified.
Website preview parity, model-backed Plan generation and reviewed execution handoff remain outstanding.
Shared context and large backend execution routes need further narrowing; this is not complete state isolation.
File projections use optimistic external-file hashes; older Plan clients can omit revision checks. Unsupported recurrences are blocked.
Reports exposes recent recorded runs, not deduplicated task totals.
